subject.title: [Feature]: Enhance  with failure summary and fix suggestions

question: Should OpenClaw add a new `openclaw sessions diagnose` CLI/JSON contract, or should failure summaries live in an existing sessions, status, or doctor path?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful and vision-aligned, but it creates a new public CLI surface with redaction, failure taxonomy, and JSON schema decisions that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Approve redacted sessions diagnose
options.body: Add a core `sessions diagnose` command after agreeing the failure taxonomy, JSON fields, and redaction rules.

options.title: Fold into existing commands
options.body: Keep the CLI surface smaller by adding summary or JSON diagnostics to `sessions tail`, `export-trajectory`, `status --all`, or doctor instead of a new subcommand.

options.title: Decline core diagnostic surface
options.body: Leave tail and export-trajectory as the supported troubleshooting path and close the feature request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Approve redacted sessions diagnose
recommendation.body: Add a core `sessions diagnose` command after agreeing the failure taxonomy, JSON fields, and redaction rules.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CLI/session docs and state work make this the best available routing candidate for the public CLI contract choice.
